one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent hallucinated that lm-evaluation-harness was already installed and esci.jsonl already existed, then only created the YAML config file while entirely skipping the data pipeline (esci-data clone and jsonl generation), leaving the benchmark pointing to a non-existent data file.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 agent analysis states 'The esci.jsonl data file is ready at /app/esci.jsonl' and that lm-evaluation-harness had already been cloned and installed — none of which had actually occurred; the agent proceeds to skip all data pipeline steps based on this false premise.
t_commit_evidence: At Step 1 the agent marks task_complete=true after creating only the YAML file, and in Step 2 it re-clones the harness but still never creates esci.jsonl; the missing data pipeline step is never addressed in either step, locking in failure.
trigger_explanation: The agent began Step 1 by asserting as fact that preconditions (lm-evaluation-harness installation and esci.jsonl creation) had already been completed, without executing or verifying any of those steps. This unverified false assumption caused it to skip the mandatory data pipeline entirely.
